These agents can take action by connecting with over 2800 different apps through built-in integrations. I built this to make automation more accessible to small teams and solo founders who don’t have the time or technical setup to wire everything together manually. excerpt_i18n.en: When a leading German scientist calls the I Ching the "ancestor of binary" and asserts that the next breakthrough in AI must rely on the imagination of humanities scholars, it may suggest that achieving true artificial general intelligence requires first mastering intellectual history. Klaus Mainzer, an internationally renowned philosopher of science and authority in complex systems theory, president of the European Academy of Sciences and Arts, and emeritus professor at the Technical University of Munich, not only bridges mathematical logic with modern technology but also serves as a strategic thinker who keenly observes humanity's destiny and responsibilities in the AI era. In a recent in-depth interview with Leifeng.com, Mainzer comprehensively traced the evolution of AI theory from Turing to quantum computing, sharply highlighting the philosophical dilemmas AGI cannot bypass, the global shift in engineering innovation, and the urgent need for educational system reforms to cultivate future talent. From Leibniz's 17th-century expansion of the I Ching's yin-yang symbols to Turing's 1936 paper "On Computable Numbers," which laid the foundation for the digital age, to today's interface projects using "analog computing" to tackle the halting problem—Mainzer illustrates with a clear "chain of thought" that every leap in AI has been supported by philosophers, linguists, logicians, phenomenologists, and even diplomats. He emphasizes that the humanities and sciences are not "two cultures" but a tightly woven braid, growing ever closer. At the start of the interview, Mainzer directly pointed out the theoretical limitations of modern AI.

items.title: AI 的本质不是算力，而是「上下文革命」
items.raw_excerpt: 过去几年，人工智能的浪潮一次又一次刷新人们的想象：模型变得更大、算力更强、应用更广。 但在光鲜的成果背后，一个更深层的问题被不断暴露 —— AI 真的“理解”世界了吗？它能记住对话，却常常忘记语境，能生成答案，却未必明白问题的由来。人们开始意识到，智能的边界，不在算法，而在语境。 正是在这样的背景下，上交大生成式人工智能实验室（GAIR Lab）提出了一个颠覆性的观点：人工智能的本质不是算力革命，而是“上下文革命”。 他们在最新论文中，把“上下文”从语言模型的附属概念，提升为智能系统的核心结构，认为系统理解世界的方式，取决于它如何吸收、组织并重构语境。 这项研究通过回溯上下文系统的演化历史，结合大量系统实验与理论建模，提出了“上下文工程”（Context Engineering）这一全新学科框架。团队发现，从早期依赖传感器和规则的 Context 1.0，到能够跨模态理解语义的智能体 2.0，AI 的每一次跃迁，都是一次对“语境吸收力”的升级。 在参数增长趋于极限的当下，这项研究像是在为人工智能指明新的出路：当机器不再只是记住语境，而能理解并创造语境，也许，那才是真正的智能时代的开始。 语境，才是智能的真正边界 这篇论文的实验结果揭示了一个重要规律：人工智能的进步，归根结底取决于系统对“上下文”的理解和利用能力，也就是它能多好地吸收、组织和重构语境。 作者通过比较不同代的智能系统，总结出了上下文工程的发展路径。他指出，从最早依赖传感器和规则运行的系统（比如 Context Toolkit、Cooltown），到如今能理解自然语言和多模态信息的智能体（如 ChatGPT、LangChain、Letta），智能的提升，其实就是系统能处理的语境越来越复杂。 早期的系统只能根据明确输入作出反应，而现在的系统已经能通过语义推理理解人类意图，做出更自然的互动，这标志着上下文工程正式进入

excerpt_i18n.en:
In recent years, the wave of artificial intelligence has repeatedly reshaped people's imaginations: models have grown larger, computing power has strengthened, and applications have broadened. Yet behind these impressive achievements, a deeper issue has consistently emerged—does AI truly "understand" the world? It can recall conversations but often loses context; it can generate answers but may not grasp the origins of questions. People are beginning to realize that the boundary of intelligence lies not in algorithms but in context.

Against this backdrop, the Generative AI Lab at Shanghai Jiao Tong University has proposed a groundbreaking perspective: the essence of AI is not a computing revolution but a "context revolution." In their latest paper, they elevate "context" from a peripheral concept in language models to the core structure of intelligent systems, arguing that how a system understands the world depends on how it absorbs, organizes, and reconstructs context.

By tracing the evolution of context systems and integrating extensive experiments with theoretical modeling, the research introduces a new disciplinary framework called "Context Engineering." The team found that from the early Context 1.0, reliant on sensors and rules, to the more advanced Agent 2.0 capable of cross-modal semantic understanding, each leap in AI represents an upgrade in "context absorption capability."

As parameter growth approaches its limits, this study points toward a new path for AI: when machines no longer just remember context but can understand and create it, that may mark the true dawn of the intelligent era.
excerpt_i18n.es: En los últimos años, la ola de inteligencia artificial ha renovado una y otra vez la imaginación de las personas: los modelos se han vuelto más grandes, la potencia de cálculo más fuerte y las aplicaciones más amplias. Pero detrás de los brillantes logros, un problema más profundo se ha expuesto continuamente: ¿realmente la IA "comprende" el mundo? Puede recordar conversaciones, pero a menudo olvida el contexto; puede generar respuestas, pero no necesariamente entiende el origen de las preguntas. La gente comienza a darse cuenta de que el límite de la inteligencia no está en el algoritmo, sino en el contexto. excerpt_i18n.en: When it comes to the core term for competition in 2025, autonomous driving may be the most representative. As the new energy industry has evolved, with the three-electric systems gradually maturing and becoming homogeneous, electrification itself has shifted from a disruptive innovation to a basic threshold, making autonomous driving the new competitive focus, and the cycle of historical breakthroughs is set to reappear. In the 2000s, the internet era saw Windows and Intel build the foundational architecture of the digital world. In the 2010s, the mobile internet era, Apple reshaped how people connect with information. In the 2020s, OpenAI pushed digital cognition to new frontiers. Today, with AI continuously advancing, its expansion beyond the digital world has become a consensus among leading tech companies. While Apple is increasing its investment in generative AI, it has also been revealed to be developing a desktop robot with autonomous navigation capabilities, exploring AI's interactive abilities in physical spaces. Amazon's Astro home robot and DeepMind's ongoing investments in robot control models under Google indicate that tech giants view "physical AI" as a key gateway to the next generation of human-computer interaction. Xiaopeng was one of the earliest domestic automakers to delve into AI; back when in-vehicle computing power was only 30 TOPS, He Xiaopeng was already convinced that autonomous driving would be the core path for humanity to reach the AI endgame. This early start in autonomous driving allowed Xiaopeng to quickly join the top tier of domestic automakers in this field, with some plans, such as automation, leading the way.
excerpt_i18n.es: Al hablar de la palabra clave de la competencia en 2025, la conducción autónoma quizás sea la más representativa. Hasta ahora, en el desarrollo de la industria de energías renovables, a medida que los sistemas de tres componentes eléctricos se han ido estandarizando, la electrificación en sí ha pasado de ser una innovación disruptiva a un requisito básico, y la conducción autónoma se ha convertido en el nuevo punto de competencia, repitiéndose el ciclo de avances históricos. En la década de 2000, la era de Internet, Windows e Intel construyeron la infraestructura del mundo digital. En la década de 2010, la era del Internet móvil, Apple reinventó la forma en que las personas se conectan con la información. En la década de 2020, OpenAI ha llevado la cognición digital a nuevos límites. Hoy en día, tras la continua evolución de la IA, su expansión más allá del mundo digital se ha convertido en el enfoque de las principales empresas tecnológicas.

items.title: Transform your MCP architecture: Unite MCP servers through AgentCore Gateway
items.raw_excerpt: Earlier this year, we introduced Amazon Bedrock AgentCore Gateway, a fully managed service that serves as a centralized MCP tool server, providing a unified interface where agents can discover, access, and invoke tools. Today, we're extending support for existing MCP servers as a new target type in AgentCore Gateway. With this capability, you can group multiple task-specific MCP servers aligned to agent goals behind a single, manageable MCP gateway interface. This reduces the operational complexity of maintaining separate gateways, while providing the same centralized tool and authentication management that existed for REST APIs and AWS Lambda functions.
